_comment: === prompt_config.json TEMPLATE v2.0 === Read this entire file before filling. Keep all fields. Replace values inside <...> placeholders. Delete _comment fields in the final output.
_resolution_comment: Batch defaults to 4K + auto. See references/image-routing-taxonomy.md#ai-image-size-matrix for all 24 tier/ratio sizes; explicit legacy WIDTHxHEIGHT is also accepted.
_output_dir_comment: Relative to the workspace; generated assets stay in the run's intermediate directory.
_max_workers_comment: Max concurrent API calls. Default 4, max 8. Single upstream only.
_max_retries_comment: Retries per image on transient failure.
_timeout_comment: API timeout in seconds per image generation call.
global_prompt: <unified environment description for all images: OS, theme, font, layout, style — do NOT describe individual image content here>
_global_prompt_comment: The global_prompt defines the SHARED visual environment. Individual image.prompt fields add per-image content on top of this. They must be semantically compatible.

global_constraints._comment: Structured environment constraints. Each image.prompt must not violate these.

scene_anchor._comment: Scene anchor for cross-image consistency. All images in the same consistency_group must share these values.

image_policy._comment: Global policy applied to all images in this batch.
image_policy._forbid_localhost_comment: false = allow localhost as real app URL; only avoid fake production domains

images._comment: === Image entry template v2.0. Copy this block for each image. ===
images.name: img_001
images._name_comment: Must follow img_NNN format: img_001, img_002, ... continuous numbers, no gaps.
images._asset_type_comment: One of: screenshot, diagram, ui_mockup, photo, illustration.
images._mode_comment: screenshot_strict (for screenshot), diagram_strict (for diagram), generic (for others).
images._resolution_comment: auto inherits the batch tier; the ratio follows a reference image or asset-type fallback. Set an explicit aspect_ratio when the request specifies one.
images._consistency_group_comment: Images sharing the same group name are checked for scene_anchor consistency.
images.prompt: <per-image content description — must be compatible with global_prompt and global_constraints>
images._fixup_type_comment: OPTIONAL. null for normal generation. Use 'clarity' for the fixed anti-blur repair prompt, or 'content' for single-point replacement fixup.
images._reference_image_comment: OPTIONAL. Set to null for txt2img. Set to a file path for img2img fixup. When non-null, prompt should describe the DESIRED CHANGE, not the full scene.

_images_comment: Each entry in images[] maps to one generated image. total_count must equal the length of this array. For img2img fixup images, include reference_image; for txt2img, omit it.
